summary: Assign existing users to an organization from its Users tab with Assign Users, then pick roles. The tab shows direct and indirect (team-based) roles; a "team member" role signals indirect assignment, visible through View indirectly-assigned organization roles.
questions: How do I add a user to an organization?
How do I see a user's indirectly assigned organization roles?
Why does a user show the team member role?
Does the user need to exist before adding to an organization?
